DAMN.

wow yeah. other than brian herold, everyone has been to like 2+ day 3s BEFORE this year (i think)

So since Brian Herold's decklists were posted as part of the coverage during the 2nd or 3rd game, does that mean the remainder of the top 8 will have their decklists posted tonight as well?

probably the most stacked since like 2007 (chu, desai, gemme, fred, me, tom h, angelo, hunter)

Fagnos = Bubble Boy

And nobody has to play one of their teammates in the first round, which is nice for a change.

The rest of the lists are posted, and the standings are slightly off -- Shannon is #6 and Herold is #5. Their SOS was tied, so there was initially some uncertainty.
